title: Variational analysis of determinantal varieties
abstract: arXiv:2511.22613v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Determinantal varieties---the sets of bounded-rank matrices or tensors---have attracted growing interest in low-rank optimization. The tangent cone to low-rank sets is widely studied and underpins a range of geometric methods. The second-order geometry, which encodes curvature information, is more intricate. In this work, we develop a unified framework to derive explicit formulas for both first- and second-order tangent sets to various low-rank sets, including low-rank matrices, tensors, symmetric matrices, and positive semidefinite matrices. The framework also accommodates the intersection of a low-rank set and another set satisfying some assumptions, thereby yielding a tangent intersection rule. Through the lens of tangent sets, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which a nonsmooth problem and its smooth parameterization share equivalent second-order stationary points. translated_abstract: 行列式簇——即秩有界的矩阵或张量集合——在低秩优化领域引起了越来越多的关注。低秩集合的切锥已被广泛研究，并支撑了一系列几何方法；而编码曲率信息的二阶几何则更为复杂。在本工作中，我们开发了一个统一框架，用于推导各类低秩集合的一阶与二阶切集的显式公式，包括低秩矩阵、张量、对称矩阵以及半正定矩阵。该框架还适用于低秩集合与另一满足某些假设的集合的交集，从而给出了切集相交规则。通过切集的视角，我们建立了一个充要条件，在该条件下非光滑问题与其光滑参数化具有等价的二阶稳定点。作为应用，我们利用切……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出统一的变分分析框架，推导出各类低秩集合（矩阵、张量、对称矩阵、半正定矩阵等）的一阶与二阶切集显式公式及切集相交规则，并据此给出了非光滑问题与其光滑参数化具有等价二阶稳定点的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified variational analysis framework that derives explicit formulas for first- and second-order tangent sets of various low-rank sets (matrices, tensors, symmetric and positive semidefinite matrices) together with tangent intersection rules, and establishes a necessary and sufficient condition under which a nonsmooth problem and its smooth parameterization share equivalent second-order stationary points.
